questions.title: Maximum Sum of a Subarray of Size K
questions.svg_html: <svg viewBox="0 0 820 330" width="100%" height="100%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="820" height="330" rx="20" fill="#f8fbff"/><text x="35" y="48" font-family="Arial" font-size="23" font-weight="700" fill="#16324f">Find the maximum sum of K consecutive elements.</text><text x="35" y="88" font-family="Arial" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Input: nums = [2, 1, 5, 1, 3, 2], K = 3</text><g font-family="Arial" font-size="25" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle"><rect x="35" y="116" width="345" height="72" rx="14" fill="#dff1ff" stroke="#2b78c5" stroke-width="4"/><text x="92" y="161">2</text><text x="150" y="161">1</text><text x="208" y="161">5</text><text x="266" y="161">1</text><text x="324" y="161">3</text><text x="372" y="161">2</text></g><text x="35" y="230" font-family="Arial" font-size="19" fill="#16324f">Window sums: 8, 7, 9, 6</text><text x="35" y="268" font-family="Arial" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#13745b">Output: 9</text><text x="35" y="305" font-family="Arial" font-size="17" fill="#5f6f7f">Target complexity: O(n) time, O(1) extra space</text></svg>

questions.title: First Negative Number in Every Window
questions.svg_html: <svg viewBox="0 0 820 340" width="100%" height="100%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="820" height="340" rx="20" fill="#f8fbff"/><text x="35" y="48" font-family="Arial" font-size="23" font-weight="700" fill="#16324f">Report the first negative value in every window of size K.</text><text x="35" y="88" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" fill="#425b72">Input: [12, -1, -7, 8, -15, 30, 16, 28], K = 3</text><rect x="35" y="115" width="750" height="70" rx="14" fill="#eaf6ff" stroke="#2b78c5" stroke-width="3"/><text x="55" y="157" font-family="Arial" font-size="23" fill="#16324f">[12, -1, -7]  → -1      [-1, -7, 8] → -1</text><text x="35" y="226" font-family="Arial" font-size="23" font-weight="700" fill="#13745b">Output: [-1, -1, -7, -15, -15, 0]</text><text x="35" y="270" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" fill="#425b72">Use 0 when a window contains no negative number.</text><text x="35" y="310" font-family="Arial" font-size="17" fill="#5f6f7f">Target complexity: O(n) time; store useful negative indices only.</text></svg>

questions.title: Maximum Vowels in a Substring of Length K
questions.svg_html: <svg viewBox="0 0 820 330" width="100%" height="100%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="820" height="330" rx="20" fill="#f8fbff"/><text x="35" y="48" font-family="Arial" font-size="23" font-weight="700" fill="#16324f">Find the most vowels in any substring of length K.</text><text x="35" y="90" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" fill="#425b72">Input: s = "abciiidef", K = 3</text><g font-family="Arial" font-size="30" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle"><text x="80" y="160">a</text><text x="130" y="160">b</text><text x="180" y="160">c</text><rect x="203" y="120" width="160" height="60" rx="12" fill="#d7f6eb" stroke="#15966f" stroke-width="4"/><text x="230" y="160">i</text><text x="282" y="160">i</text><text x="336" y="160">i</text><text x="390" y="160">d</text><text x="440" y="160">e</text><text x="490" y="160">f</text></g><text x="35" y="230" font-family="Arial" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="#13745b">Output: 3</text><text x="35" y="271" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" fill="#425b72">The substring "iii" contains three vowels.</text><text x="35" y="307" font-family="Arial" font-size="17" fill="#5f6f7f">Stop early if the count reaches K.</text></svg>

questions.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
questions.svg_html: <svg viewBox="0 0 820 340" width="100%" height="100%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="820" height="340" rx="20" fill="#f8fbff"/><text x="35" y="48" font-family="Arial" font-size="23" font-weight="700" fill="#16324f">Find the longest substring containing no repeated character.</text><text x="35" y="90" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" fill="#425b72">Input: s = "abcabcbb"</text><rect x="34" y="118" width="180" height="70" rx="14" fill="#d7f6eb" stroke="#15966f" stroke-width="4"/><g font-family="Arial" font-size="30" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle"><text x="65" y="163">a</text><text x="120" y="163">b</text><text x="175" y="163">c</text><text x="235" y="163">a</text><text x="290" y="163">b</text><text x="345" y="163">c</text><text x="400" y="163">b</text><text x="455" y="163">b</text></g><text x="35" y="235" font-family="Arial" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="#13745b">Output: 3</text><text x="35" y="276" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" fill="#425b72">"abc" is a longest valid substring.</text><text x="35" y="314" font-family="Arial" font-size="17" fill="#5f6f7f">Variable window: move left beyond the last duplicate position.</text></svg>

questions.title: Smallest Subarray With Sum at Least Target
questions.svg_html: <svg viewBox="0 0 820 350" width="100%" height="100%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="820" height="350" rx="20" fill="#f8fbff"/><text x="35" y="48" font-family="Arial" font-size="23" font-weight="700" fill="#16324f">Find the minimum length whose sum is at least target.</text><text x="35" y="89" font-family="Arial" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Input: target = 7, nums = [2, 3, 1, 2, 4, 3]</text><g font-family="Arial" font-size="29" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle"><text x="70" y="165">2</text><text x="130" y="165">3</text><text x="190" y="165">1</text><text x="250" y="165">2</text><rect x="278" y="122" width="125" height="64" rx="13" fill="#ffe8cf" stroke="#f28c28" stroke-width="4"/><text x="310" y="165">4</text><text x="370" y="165">3</text></g><text x="35" y="236" font-family="Arial" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="#13745b">Output: 2</text><text x="35" y="278" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" fill="#425b72">The subarray [4, 3] has sum 7 and length 2.</text><text x="35" y="318" font-family="Arial" font-size="17" fill="#5f6f7f">Assume all numbers are positive. Return 0 if no answer exists.</text></svg>
